note: Luminos containment + simplified energy ramp + main-chart maximize. Three small things in one ship. (1) overflow:hidden on the luminos layer — sprites animate to left:-5%/105% to create an edge fade and were leaking into the sidebar without clipping. Caught by Opus. (2) Energy ramp simplified per Opus to ONE CSS var (--lum-energy) that drives both size and layer opacity via calc(); removes the binary tg-signal-strong/extreme size jumps in favor of a smooth gradient. Tier classes still set filter (blur, saturate) for the temperature-strength dimension. Three orthogonal dimensions are now cleanly separated: color=direction, filter=strength, size+opacity=energy, motion=instability. (3) Main-chart maximize via right-click menu (tgMaximizeMainChart). Same affordance the sub-charts already had. Escape unsticks the main chart's fullscreen too.
